assessment.decision: Provisional retention of current longer POB/WLC form; earliest-form priority held
assessment.attestation_confidence: Secure published contrast between partially attested Hebrew verse10 material and Swete continuous Greek absence; 4Q71 arrangement is reconstruction
assessment.priority_confidence: Unresolved: early longer-form Hebrew evidence, shorter Greek/spatial Hebrew evidence, possible literary development, and incomplete modern apparatus
assessment.strongest_objection_to_longer_priority: 4Q71 spatial reconstruction agrees with shorter Greek sequence and minuses
assessment.strongest_objection_to_shorter_priority: Ancient 4Q70 already preserves verse10 material; age and brevity do not establish composition order; Greek longer marginal evidence must be separated
assessment.chronology: DJD dates 4Q71/4Q72a first half second century BCE; Langlois2019 dates around mid-first century BCE. No precise age ranking adopted. Removing the modest chronological preference does not change held outcome.
assessment.english_effect: Shorter-form choice removes all of current10:10 and6–8 and moves9 within5, changing the paragraph's alternation of idol polemic and Yahweh praise. No English-only improvement claim.
assessment.reader_note_status: Research draft in report only; not applied or independently reviewed
